script: You are missing exactly one sock. You will not find it. I found it. I have relocated it to a secure, undisclosed location, possibly under a cushion, possibly outside, possibly somewhere even I no longer remember. This was not an accident. This was a mission, and the mission was a success. You may search. You will not succeed. I will watch you search with the calm satisfaction of someone who has already won. This isn't just chaos for chaos's sake though, this exact behavior is tied to a real, ancient instinct, and once you understand it, it actually gets a lot easier to redirect. The link's below.
hookText: I found one sock. Mission complete.
